name: Société Anonyme
description: French SA template using the board-of-directors model. It covers governance, statutory registers and equity; a SA with a management board and supervisory board needs a tailored template.

organs.name: Board of directors
organs.description: Board of directors in the standard French SA governance model.

organs.name: Executive management
organs.description: Chairman, Chief Executive Officer and delegated chief executives appointed by the board where applicable.

organs.name: Bylaws
organs.description: Append-only history of the versions of the bylaws adopted by the extraordinary general meeting.

organs.name: Board minutes
organs.description: Append-only register of board deliberations and resolutions.

organs.name: Résolutions de l’assemblée générale
organs.description: Append-only register of each general-meeting decision and its recorded result, separate from the signed minutes.

organs.name: Procès-verbaux d’assemblée générale
organs.description: Append-only register of final signed general-meeting minutes, maintained only by Executive management.

organs.name: Financial statements
organs.description: Append-only register of the annual financial statements approved by the general meeting.

organs.name: Payments
organs.description: Assets and token balances available for payments approved through the payment procedure.

procedures.name: Appoint directors
procedures.description: The ordinary general meeting appoints, renews or revokes directors.

procedures.name: Appoint executive management
procedures.description: The board appoints or revokes the Chairman, CEO and delegated chief executives where applicable.

procedures.name: Make a payment
procedures.description: The Board of directors approves payments from the Payments organ.

procedures.name: Approve share transfer
procedures.description: The board decides on a holder-initiated transfer when an approval clause in the bylaws applies, and the share token records the movement.

procedures.name: Amend bylaws
procedures.description: The extraordinary general meeting adopts an amendment to the bylaws.

procedures.name: Record board resolution
procedures.description: The board records a deliberation that does not belong to a more specific procedure.

procedures.name: Archive meeting minutes
procedures.description: Executive management appends the final signed meeting minutes to the append-only minutes register.
